discovery.english: Official Punjab Land Records Cadastral Map, Punjab OneMap, and Batala municipal sources were found. The state cadastral page exposes Gurdaspur district and a village-wise workflow, but no anonymous parcel feature response was verified.
discovery.native: ਪੰਜਾਬੀ ਅਧਿਕਾਰਤ ਖੋਜ ਵਿੱਚ ਪੰਜਾਬ ਲੈਂਡ ਰਿਕਾਰਡਜ਼ ਦਾ Cadastral Map ਮੋਡੀਊਲ ਮਿਲਿਆ; ਗੁਰਦਾਸਪੁਰ ਜ਼ਿਲ੍ਹਾ ਚੋਣ ਉਪਲਬਧ ਹੈ, ਪਰ ਅਨਾਮ ਪਾਰਸਲ ID ਅਤੇ ਜਿਆਮਿਤੀ ਦਾ ਉੱਤਰ ਪ੍ਰਮਾਣਿਤ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੋਇਆ।

custodian.name: Department of Revenue, Rehabilitation and Disaster Management, Government of Punjab, India
custodian.role: State land-record and village-wise cadastral-map custodian; relevant district selection is Gurdaspur. Batala municipal administration is corroborating local context, not an evidenced parcel feed.

attemptedRoutes.route: Punjab Land Records Cadastral Map landing/viewer
attemptedRoutes.result: HTTP 200; current bilingual ASP.NET form exposes Jamabandi period, district, tehsil, village, and year selectors. Gurdaspur is listed. No parcel feature schema, CRS, ID, or geometry in the landing response.

attemptedRoutes.route: Punjab Land Records current page JavaScript
attemptedRoutes.result: HTTP 200; inspected script did not expose an anonymous public parcel-service URL or ID-plus-geometry response contract.
HTTP 200; official NIC-developed GIS portal shell, but no bounded safe parcel response was exposed by the public landing route.
HTTP 200; confirms the local municipal administration and Batala context; no parcel geometry endpoint.

Not executed as a direct POST: the page depends on ASP.NET hidden state and sequential postbacks, while no public service contract was exposed. No credentials, CAPTCHA bypass, or guessed unsafe query was attempted.

geometryReview.reason: No bounded anonymous response containing both a stable native parcel identity and polygon geometry was available from the first-party routes inspected; no polygon is retained.

scopeLimits: Exact WUP point [31.8176384783392, 75.2046803289866] was preserved in latitude/longitude order and was not shifted to force a parcel hit.
No exact-point hit, map extent miss, timeout, login wall, or unusable UI was used as evidence of citywide absence.
State-level service evidence was distinguished from local Batala municipal context and not promoted to an open geometry feed.

qualification.uncertainty: Postback-discovered selector behavior, village-level availability, public response schema, CRS, safe native identity field, and citywide coverage remain unverified.
